newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica IBCA says Sentrachem off rate watch.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica IBCA says Sentrachem off rate watch.

text.p: Rating agency IBCA said on Thursday it had taken chemicals group Sentrachem Ltd off its RatingWatch with negative implications and maintained the firm's domestic long (A-) and short-term (A2) ratings.

It said in a statement the decision to place the group on a rating watch followed the severe loss incurred in the first half of its 1997 financial year due mainly to forex losses and restructuring costs at agrochemicals unit, Sanachem.
Greater clarity needed to be obtained on the near term financial performance of the group and specifically its cash flow, IBCA said.
The agency also needed to assess how the high level of gearing was going to be addressed.
In its assessment, IBCA said financial risk had heightened and the group's financial flexibility been substantially reduced in the past 18 months.

This was initially due to the acquisition of unit Hampshire Chemicals, which -- combined with other factors -- resulted in a rating downgrade. More recently, restructuring costs and management changes at subsidiary Sanachem had exacerbated the group's financial risk and added to reduced financial flexibility.
But substantial foreign denominated sales, initiatives to infuse more stability in earnings and the strong performance by the group's other operations provided comfort, IBCA said.
"Although the ratings are taken off RatingWatch with negative implications and maintained at A2 and A-, the group's performance will be monitored closely," it said.
